home.whoDescription: DAR is a dynamic construction and engineering company committed to delivering high-quality, sustainable, and innovative solutions across a wide range of sectors, including industrial, medical, educational, and infrastructure projects. With a strong focus on quality, safety, and client satisfaction, we transform ideas into successful realities through professional project execution, technical expertise, and a dedication to excellence. At DAR, we build more than structures—we build trust, long-term partnerships, and a better future.
